tasks.subject: Implement Milestone 2 experiment engine
tasks.description: Implement the user-approved user-authored relational Experiment Engine. Contract: no Experiment ontology kind and no agent/model proposals; optional provenance-backed graph links with Pattern-only mobile picker; opaque user-written hypothesis/action/success criterion; 1–42 inclusive local-date duration with IANA timezone; daily/weekly/end-only cadence and no reminders; check-ins are ordinary Observations; qualitative outcome met/partly met/not met/unclear with final check-in; deterministic lifecycle, strict user isolation, optimistic concurrency/idempotency, neutral non-medical framing. Include migration, domain/persistence/API, mobile UI/API, tests, isolated browser E2E, ADR/docs, verification, and fresh review. Preserve unrelated uncommitted work.
